limitations: Actual small-model SFT on generated diagnostic tasks; no representative enterprise or frontier-model claim.
Thirty-two underlying record families per domain share two surface templates; independence is conditional on the generator.
Validation seeds share task families and are not additional independent task samples.
Wide bounded intervals and the two-template sensitivity can remain inconclusive.
JSON validity and exact grading are separate descriptive measurements; no human semantic calibration is claimed.
Mix validation has eight primary cells; full-suite threshold crossings are descriptive, not ground truth.
Subset time savings are counterfactual; this experiment actually executed the full suite.
Measured times retain first-call compilation and cache/order effects. A separately executed subset can have different runtime.

publication.evidence_origin: actual local open-weight model training and evaluation; original generated diagnostic task population

independent_evidence_audit.method: Independent direct read-only SQLite trial audit, raw JSON parsing and exact grader reconstruction, arithmetic recomputation of every trajectory/interval/mix strategy

interpretation: Routing and extraction improve on the fixed generated task population under the declared record-family independence assumptions.
All two-surface-template dependence sensitivities remain inconclusive.
Arithmetic is at the scoring floor at every checkpoint, so unchanged scores cannot establish retained arithmetic capability.
There are zero reference regressions in primary mix validation, so regression detection recall is undefined.
The selected suite has lower mean delta error than the sampled baseline averages, while both baseline families cost less on average.
Subset time savings are a replay estimate from the actually executed full suite, not a separately measured subset deployment.
Generated fixed-template tasks, two validation training seeds and no blinded human calibration do not establish enterprise or frontier-model validity.
publication.retained_private_evidence: Original model responses, trial database, checkpoint artifacts and execution paths remain on the local study machine.
